description: The plot illustrates the training loss for different model architectures and sizes over a series of steps. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 440,000, with tick labels displayed at 0k, 20k, 40k, 60k, 80k, 420k, 430k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.85, with tick labels displayed at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 0.85. The line representing ChemBART Small 20M is red with no markers and begins at approximately 0.78 at 0k and descends to approximately 0.07 at 440k, with fluctuations between approximately 0.05 and 0.15 between 60k and 440k.  The line representing ChemBART Medium 20M is green with no markers and begins at approximately 0.76 at 0k and descends to approximately 0.06 at 440k, with fluctuations between approximately 0.04 and 0.12  between 60k and 440k. The line representing ChemBERTa Small 20M is orange with no markers and begins at approximately 0.72 at 0k and descends to approximately 0.05 at 440k, with fluctuations between approximately 0.03 and 0.10 between 60k and 440k. The line representing ChemBERTa Medium 20M is brown with no markers and begins at approximately 0.75 at 0k and descends to approximately 0.06 at 440k, with fluctuations between approximately 0.04 and 0.13 between 60k and 440k. Finally, the line representing ChemLLaMA Small 20M is purple with no markers and begins at approximately 0.76 at 0k and descends to approximately 0.07 at 440k, with fluctuations between approximately 0.05 and 0.14 between 60k and 440k.
